product_notes.CAB/RPV: 8 records (FLAIR, ATLAS, ATLAS-2M, SOLAR, CARES, LATITUDE, IMPALA, VOLITION). Approval 2021 per Cabenuva label. Screened via ctsearch cabotegravir + PubMed. Week 48 resistance for FLAIR/ATLAS from open-access pooled paper; ATLAS-2M from label. Not fully assessed: IMPALA and LATITUDE resistance details (full text not open access); trials with no results yet (ULA NCT07650916, CROWN NCT06694805, SUPLA NCT06507059, NCT07682961).
product_notes.CAB: 8 component records mirroring CAB/RPV trials (CAB is the investigational INSTI in each). Approval corrected 2020->2021 per Vocabria label. Excluded HPTN 083/084 and other PrEP studies.
product_notes.RPV/TAF/FTC: 2 records (1160, 1216). Approval 2016 per Odefsey label. No other adult Phase 3 RPV/FTC/TAF efficacy trial with results found; Co-STARs excluded (HCV primary endpoint).
product_notes.RPV/TDF/FTC: 3 records (STaR, SPIRIT, SALIF). Approval 2011 per Complera label. Not fully screened: GS-US-264-0111 (Mills 2013, PMID 24144898; reported as phase 2b), Wiriyatanakorn 2019 (phase not stated), other investigator-initiated studies.
product_notes.RPV: 2 records (ECHO, THRIVE). Approval 2011 per Edurant label. Not fully screened: TRULIGHT NCT02302547, QUATUOR, ANRS 4D (strategy trials where RPV not evaluated agent); investigator-initiated Thai trials (phase not stated).
